# Karembo Tours and Safaris

> Trusted Nairobi-based Kenyan tour company specialising in Masai Mara safaris, Big Five wildlife tours, Nairobi day trips, beach-and-bush combos and authentic cultural experiences. Local guides, competitive rates, tailor-made itineraries.

Karembo Tours and Safaris (karembotours.co.ke) is a fully licensed Kenyan tour operator based in Nairobi. We design and run private and small-group safaris across Kenya, including the Masai Mara, Amboseli, Lake Nakuru, Samburu, Tsavo and the Indian Ocean coast.

## Services

- Masai Mara safaris (3–8 days), including Great Migration tours (Jul–Oct)
- Big Five safaris combining Mara, Nakuru and Amboseli
- Honeymoon safaris and luxury tented camp packages
- Day trips from Nairobi: National Park, Giraffe Centre, Sheldrick Elephant Orphanage, Karen Blixen Museum, Bomas of Kenya, Mt. Longonot
- Bush + beach combos to Diani, Watamu and Lamu
- Maasai and Samburu cultural immersion experiences
- Airport transfers and bespoke itineraries
